The statement to prove: appending two lists adds their lengths.
Induction on xs. First case: xs is the empty list.
Both sides simplify to ys.length, so the nil case closes.
Second case: xs is x :: xs, and we get the induction hypothesis ih for the shorter list.
Simplifying with ih turns the goal into pure arithmetic about lengths.
omega solves the linear arithmetic. Both cases are closed: proof complete.
